obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: may be repaired or replaced between the tests
obligations.ears: The protective devices and the mountings attaching them to the vehicle structure may be repaired or replaced between the tests.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: When the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: a vehicle of the same type may be used for each test
obligations.ears: When the manufacturer so requests, a vehicle of the same type may be used for each test.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: the technical service responsible for conducting the tests may allow the same vehicle as is used for tests prescribed by other Regulations (including tests capable of affecting its structure) to be used also for the tests prescribed by this Regulation
obligations.ears: When the manufacturer so requests, the technical service responsible for conducting the tests may allow the same vehicle as is used for tests prescribed by other Regulations (including tests capable of affecting its structure) to be used also for the tests prescribed by this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be accurate to within one per cent
obligations.ears: The instrument used to record the speed referred to in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. above shall be accurate to within one per cent.
